title: Replace the five-pill conductor feed with a truthful task board
done_when: The conductor can open a keyboard-accessible task surface that shows every open task without truncating its distinguishing brief, visibly separates pending, overdue, in_review, rework and terminal states, focuses the target pane from a task, bounds finished history, and tests prove a sixth concurrent task stays visible and that terminal silence is never labelled blocked without an explicit blocked event (BACKLOG.md:629).
